text:
marta: Heads up — EU depot FRA-4 found 12 units with firmware mismatch vs image on manifest. Vendor is asking for photo evidence to approve air-expedite RMA. They need signoff before today's ship cutoff 16:00 CET. Can procurement / vendor team confirm photos ok?

alex: Can you drop serials + quick photos here? I'll check warranty window.

marta: Serials: RDW-FRA-0001, RDW-FRA-0002, RDW-FRA-0003, RDW-FRA-0004, RDW-FRA-0005, RDW-FRA-0006, RDW-FRA-0007, RDW-FRA-0008, RDW-FRA-0009, RDW-FRA-0010, RDW-FRA-0011, RDW-FRA-0012
Uploaded photos: https://redwood.internal/attachments/180123/units_photos.zip :eyes:

priya: Vendor requires 3 photos per unit: 1) front label (serial visible), 2) board close-up showing HW sticker, 3) outer box with AWB. Also need depot tech holding a paper with the serial (chain-of-custody).

marta: Uploading sample inspection (unit RDW-FRA-0003): https://redwood.internal/attachments/180123/0003_sample.jpg

sam: If vendor declines expedite, suggest temp swap with loaner pool. We have 6 loaners in EU pool. @alex can you confirm insurance/lease for swap? :thinking_face:

alex: Lease team ok. Cost delta: air-expedite ≈ €4.5k for 12 units vs loaner swap + crossdock ≈ €3.2k + 3 days SLA hit. Which is preferable for the customer?

priya: Customer SLA > cost for this account. Vendor has historically approved expedite when full photo packet + inspection log provided. I'll ping vendor ops and attach the sample.

rui: Carrier ready — pickup window 15:30 CET if labels printed. AWB placeholder: 1Z9999EU12345. Printing labels now. Important: customs HS code must be 8473.30 per vendor paperwork or we'll see extra hold time.

marta: Sample inspection log:
```
inspector: lina
unit: RDW-FRA-0003
firmware_found: 2.1.4
manifest_expected: 2.2.0
action_taken: photo_evidence_collected
notes: small label peel, no physical damage
```

rma-bot: RMA ticket created RMA-2026-8812. VendorOps notified.

priya: @vendorops any ETA on authorizing air-expedite once we deliver photos?

vendorops-bot: VendorOps ack — received package. Will review within 1 hour. If approved we'll provide expedited label and update AWB.

marta: We need explicit approval by 15:45 CET to make today's cutoff. Otherwise proceed with loaner swap to avoid SLA breach. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: Agreed. If vendor approves we'll absorb expedite cost for this customer — @finance FYI.

priya: pinged vendorops contact (john.doe@vendor.com). He said he'll prioritize; expects decision in ~30m. :thumbsup:

rui: I'll stage pickup docs + temporary manifest changes. If approved, please confirm final AWB and I'll update courier.

marta: Thanks — posting final photo bundle link after I finish QC: https://redwood.internal/attachments/180123/final_bundle_180123.zip

sam: Noted. If vendor denies, I'll start loaner choreography at 16:00 CET.

marta: closing loop here once vendor responds. Thanks team.
